text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Apple’s most recently completed fiscal year was FY2024, ended September 28, 2024. FY2024 revenue was $391 billion, up 2% from $383 billion in FY2023. Net income was $94 billion, or $6.20 per share, compared with $97 billion, or $6.13, in FY2023; EPS was roughly flat. Gross margin was about 46%, operating margin about 31%, and net margin around 24%. Operating cash flow was about $118 billion, with free cash flow around $96 billion. In FY2023, revenue declined slightly to $383 billion from $394 billion in FY2022, while net income fell to $97 billion from $100 billion in FY2022. FY2022 revenue was $394 billion, up 8% from $366 billion in FY2021, with EPS of $6.11 and net income of $100 billion. FY2021 revenue was $366 billion, up 7%, with EPS of $4.30 and net income of $82 billion. Services offset weaker hardware, but China exposure and demand concerns persisted. View: AAPL shares look rangebound, supported by cash generation and buybacks, but valuation and iPhone momentum warrant caution."}
